description: "Devereux — Complete" by Edward Bulwer Lytton is a semi-autobiographical novel written in the early 19th century. The narrative follows the life of Morton Devereux, who reflects upon his upbringing, family dynamics, and the formation of his character amidst the societal expectations of a bygone era.
